hypothesis: High prior-session SOXX shock concentration amplifies marginal segment drawdown of adding nominal beta when own received drawdown is already high; a fee-net value maximizing actor can then avoid harmful added risk without surrendering good SOXX/SOXL opportunities.
source_clock: shock21 prior full session known before 09:29; z5 own received drawdown and projected u action known at each legal minute; next-bar fill remains future
control_basis: z0..z9, u0/u1, all z_i*u_j, quadratic u0²/u0u1/u1², quoted_fee_fraction, shock main, shock*z5 state-only; same rows and scaler for matched arms
training: 2018-10-15 through 2019-12-31 role=fit, risk_known and value_known with label_available_at strictly before 2020-01-01
evaluation: 2020-01-01 through 2020-12-31 role=held, score every saved physical action before outcome; mature known labels only for metrics, full 248 source-day calendar retained
models: shared fee-net value Ridge(alpha=100), matched risk control Ridge(alpha=100), risk candidate Ridge(alpha=100) adding only candidate feature; weighted StandardScaler fit on training days only; each day total weight one
risk_prediction: clip both risk heads to [received_drawdown,1]; shared value forecast unchanged
local_actor: For each anchor choose maximum shared predicted fee-net value among three saved held physical actions and HOLD whose predicted risk <=0.30; fixed ties prefer HOLD then action_id. HOLD predicted risk is scored at u=(0,0), fee=0, not future realized HOLD risk. If no arm passes, choose HOLD. Candidate/control/same-model-zero use identical rule.
information_gate: On 2020 held actions candidate day-weighted risk MSE strictly below matched control and train-day mean, coefficient positive, 10-session circular-block lower on control-minus-candidate loss positive
action_gate: At least20 independent days changed by candidate versus same-model-zero and versus matched control; selected unknown outcomes zero; candidate-minus-control realized fee-net local value mean and 10-session block lower positive; candidate value versus HOLD lower positive; candidate-minus-control realized risk damage 10-session upper <=0 Shared value calibration gate must also pass.
account_admission: Local held-action gate passing is necessary only. A later continuous own-state Qlib actor with full action support, PSD/quantile risk parity, next-open whole shares/Tiered/dividends and exact f696+b472 matched parent must be frozen and run before any SOXX claim.
stop: If source, information or action gate fails, close this exact source/state/action version without changing alpha, sign, risk budget, action set, year or threshold; record method/coverage and move to a distinct mechanism.
limits: pi2 state policy was trained on reused 2018-2020 development history; held means held physical action IDs not independent market OOF
